summary: Wallbox N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting on May 22, 2026. The filing details reappointment of directors, including Executive Director Enric Asunción Escorsa and several non-executive directors, plus authorization for share buybacks and a pledge/warrant proposal in connection with restructuring. Vote totals show strong support across items. The registrant is Wallbox, the issuer. This is a routine meeting outcome, not a forced departure, so it defaults to routine. Confidence medium due to restructuring mentions but no abrupt change.
